description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 20, 2026 (Colorado Springs, CO) — The Victor Marx for Governor campaign announced today a massive surge in grassroots momentum, successfully raising $1 million since the first of the year. Reaching this unprecedented milestone in just 78 days brings the campaign’s total raised war chest to an excess of $1,600,000, solidly outpacing all other Republican candidates in the field.
